sources.title: LOPDP — Personal-data security and risk duties — official reference
sources.locator: Articles 37–43 security, risks, by-design, impact and breach notification; Art 47 responsibilities

limitations: This is a partial offline evidence mapping. It does not establish legal compliance, a national security grade, certification, scan permission or vulnerability confirmation.
Current implementing regulation and SPDP resolutions are not exhausted by this law map. Optional mechanisms in Art 37 must not be converted into unconditional mandatory technology checks.
